name: Ataa Educational Company
summary: Ataa Educational Company engages in the establishment ownership, management, operation, and formation of private and international, kindergarten, primary, intermediate, and secondary schools for boys and girls in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Education, Employment, and Recruitment segments. The company establishes and manages private, international, and French and Indian schools; and colleges and universities. It is also involved in owning, establishment, management, operation, and maintenance of vocational and other training centers, private educational schools, and educational and training institutes; purchasing existing schools, and educational and training facilities; …
